_about: Word tables for the cleanup gate and guards (S-12a, fork/llm/markers.rs). Our own data, GPL-3.0-or-later with the repository. `hesitations`: sounds that are never content (an input of only these may clean to nothing). `fillers`: exactly the owner's filler policy table (eval/cleanup/README.md, "Discourse markers"): discourse markers and lead-ins that Light removes when they carry no content; they are never required back by the content-word check, and non-English prompts name them. `repairs`: self-correction markers; up to three words before one may be dropped by a correct repair, so the guards do not require them back. `stopwords`: the eval scorer's short lists (scripts/wb-eval-cleanup.ts), used to pick content words. `openers`: replies that start like an assistant ("Sure, …"), rejected unless the input starts the same way. `assistant_markers`: text that marks a reply about the transcript rather than the transcript; the first eight are Muesli's (Qwen3PostProcessor.swift, MIT, docs/fork/PORTS.md), the rest are prompt-framing echoes. Phrases are lower-case and matched whole-word. `frames` (optional): sentence-opening frames that say nothing ("what I wanted to say is"), a lead-in under the owner's policy; a cleanup may drop them at the start of a sentence, never elsewhere. `alternatives` (optional): the word for "or"; a repair right after it ("put it in the drive or actually email it") may replace the whole clause back to the sentence start.
